en.name: Cranberry sauce, homemade
en.summary: Homemade cranberry sauce is cranberries cooked down with sugar and usually orange or lemon, which gives it both acidity and sugar working in its favour. Refrigerated it keeps 7–10 days, which comfortably covers a holiday weekend and the week after. Freezing is not recommended.
en.pantry: Homemade cranberry sauce is not shelf-stable and should not be left out. Cool it and refrigerate it within two hours of cooking, or one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). The sugar and the acidity help it keep once it is cold, but they are not a substitute for refrigeration in an uncanned, home-cooked sauce. At the table, serve it in a bowl and return the rest to the fridge rather than leaving the whole batch out through a long meal.
en.fridge: Cool it, cover it and keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, where it holds 7–10 days. A glass or ceramic container is better than metal, which the acid can taint. Spoon out what you need with a clean spoon rather than serving directly from the storage container, and never tip leftovers from the table back in. The sauce will firm up considerably in the cold; let it stand or stir it to loosen before serving.
en.freezer: Freezing cranberry sauce is not recommended, as after thawing it may become too watery, and no freezer timeline is given for it. The set that makes the sauce hold together breaks down through a freeze and thaw. Better to make the quantity you will eat over the following week, and if you overshoot, cook the surplus down further into a glaze or stir it into something else within the fridge window.
spoilage: Mould spots on the surface or around the rim
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
Fizzing or bubbling in a sauce that should be still
A watery layer separating out with a dull, brownish colour
tips: Cool it quickly in a shallow dish before refrigerating.
Store in glass or ceramic rather than metal; the acid taints metal.
Serve from a separate bowl to keep the stored batch untouched.
Make it a day or two ahead — the flavour improves and it saves time on the day.

faq.q: How long does homemade cranberry sauce last in the fridge?
Can you freeze homemade cranberry sauce?
faq.a: It is not recommended. After thawing it may become too watery, and no freezer timeline is given for it.

faq.q: Can you make cranberry sauce ahead of time?
faq.a: Yes, and it is worth doing. Made a few days before a meal it keeps well within its fridge window and the flavour settles.

faq.q: How can you tell if cranberry sauce has gone bad?
faq.a: Mould, a yeasty or alcoholic smell, or any fizzing. All three mean the batch goes out.

zh.name: 自製蔓越莓醬
zh.summary: 自製蔓越莓醬是把蔓越莓和糖、通常再加柳橙或檸檬一起熬煮而成，同時具備酸度和糖度兩項優勢。冷藏可放 7～10 天，足以撐過節日週末和接下來的一週。不建議冷凍。
zh.pantry: 自製蔓越莓醬不是常溫保存品，不能放在外面。煮好後放涼，並在兩小時內冷藏，廚房超過 32 °C 時縮短為一小時。糖和酸度在冷藏狀態下確實有幫助，但對一鍋沒有做殺菌裝罐的自製醬來說，它們不能取代冷藏。上桌時請另外裝碗，其餘放回冰箱，不要整鍋在餐桌上擺一整場飯局。
zh.fridge: 放涼、加蓋，放在 4 °C 以下，可放 7～10 天。用玻璃或陶瓷容器比金屬好，因為酸會讓金屬產生異味。用乾淨的湯匙取出要用的份量，不要直接從保存容器上桌，桌上剩下的也不要倒回去。醬在低溫下會凝得相當硬；上桌前先回溫一下或攪拌開即可。
zh.freezer: 蔓越莓醬不建議冷凍，因為解凍後可能變得太稀，官方也沒有給冷凍期限。讓醬凝結成形的結構撐不過一次冷凍再解凍。比較好的做法是只煮接下來一週吃得完的量；真的煮太多，就在冷藏期限內把它熬得更濃做成刷醬，或拌進其他料理。
spoilage: 醬面或容器邊緣出現霉點
聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
本該安靜的醬開始冒泡或起氣
分離出一層水，顏色變得暗沉偏褐
tips: 冷藏前先用淺盤快速放涼。
用玻璃或陶瓷容器，不要用金屬；酸會讓金屬產生異味。
另外裝碗上桌，保存的那批保持沒被動過。
提前一兩天做——風味會更融合，當天也省事。

faq.q: 自製蔓越莓醬放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 加蓋放在 4 °C 以下，可放 7～10 天。

faq.q: 自製蔓越莓醬可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 不建議。解凍後可能變得太稀，而且沒有提供冷凍期限。

faq.q: 蔓越莓醬可以提前做嗎？
faq.a: 可以，而且值得。提前幾天做完全在冷藏期限內，風味也會更融合。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷蔓越莓醬壞掉了？
faq.a: 長霉、有酵母味或酒味、或開始冒泡。這三者任一出現就整批丟掉。
